candidates.entry: long XLK, XLV, XLP when 20-day dividend yield percentile (vs 1y rolling) > 70 AND 20d price momentum > 0
candidates.exit: exit when 20d dividend yield percentile drops below 30 OR 20d price momentum < -2%
candidates.sizing: equal weight across selected ETFs, target 10% annualized vol via 20d rolling vol scaling
candidates.regime_filter: skip when VIX > 25 OR 10y US Treasury yield > 5% OR SPY 20d vol > 35%
candidates.rationale: Carry factor via dividend yield in defensive sector ETFs historically delivered Sharpe ~0.65; regime filter avoids crash risk, and vol-targeting keeps MDD manageable.

candidates.entry: long XLF when (NAV - price)/NAV > 0.5% AND XLF 20d vol > 25% (high-vol regime); short XLF when (price - NAV)/NAV > 0.5% AND XLF 20d vol > 25%
candidates.exit: exit when absolute deviation < 0.1% OR after 5 trading days
candidates.sizing: fixed 50% of capital per signal, no leverage
candidates.regime_filter: skip when VIX < 15 (low-vol periods weaken signal) OR when XLF/XLE average daily volume < 10M shares
candidates.rationale: ETF arbitrage exploiting NAV deviations in high-vol periods showed Sharpe 0.7-1.0; quick mean-reversion keeps MDD low and trade count high.

candidates.entry: long top 3 sector ETFs by 12-month momentum (excluding XLRE, XLC) when their average 12m return > 10%; short bottom 3 when average 12m return < -5%
candidates.exit: exit when 1-month momentum rank drops below 5th (for longs) or rises above 5th (for shorts) OR after 6 months
candidates.sizing: equal weight long/short, gross exposure 100% long, 50% short (net long bias)
candidates.regime_filter: skip when VIX > 30 OR when 12-month cross-sectional momentum dispersion (std dev of returns) < 5%
candidates.rationale: Cross-asset momentum in sector ETFs historically Sharpe 0.6-0.8; net long bias and vol filter reduce drawdowns, but lower trade frequency expected.

candidates.entry: long XLU, XLP when both carry percentile > 60 AND 6-month momentum > 5% (double-sort); short XLY, XLB when both carry percentile < 40 AND 6-month momentum < -5%
candidates.exit: exit when either signal flips (carry percentile < 40 for longs, > 60 for shorts) OR 3-month hold
candidates.sizing: risk-parity between long and short legs targeting 12% annualized vol
candidates.regime_filter: skip when correlation between carry and momentum factors > 0.5 (rolling 60d) OR when VIX > 28
candidates.rationale: Combining low-correlation carry and momentum factors historically improves risk-adjusted returns; regime filter avoids periods of factor crowding.

candidates.entry: long XLC when 20-day RSI < 30 (oversold); short XLC when 20-day RSI > 70 (overbought)
candidates.exit: exit when RSI crosses 50 (for longs) or 50 (for shorts) OR after 10 days
candidates.sizing: fixed 100% of capital per signal, no leverage
candidates.regime_filter: skip when XLC 60d vol > 40% OR when sector concentration (top 3 holdings weight) > 60%
candidates.rationale: Diagnostic: simple mean-reversion in a single concentrated ETF (XLC) likely has no edge due to high correlation with mega-cap tech and low diversification; backtest should confirm PF < 1.0 and high MDD.
